description: Add well-controlled asthma with albuterol PRN
presentation: Patient is a 35-year old woman with a history of well-controlled asthma managed with albuterol PRN who had unprotected vaginal intercourse with a male partner who has recently been diagnosed with HIV. The patient is requesting PEP despite being outside of the 72-hour window. What testing should be ordered for this patient and is PEP indicated?
